in_marathi.name: Deepabali
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Row of Lamps
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepabali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepabali is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Deepa' meaning 'lamp' and 'Bali' meaning 'row'. This name signifies a woman who is the embodiment of light, illuminating the path of life with her wisdom and compassion. In Hindu mythology, Deepabali is also the name of a Goddess, representing the divine light that guides and protects.
